out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Cannot Exceed 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is being used as a control was not cooked, served or discarded by the expiration time as indicated: Tapioca Pearls (cooked at 8am) observed in ambient after 4 hour endpoint as indicated.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours is used as the public health control : 1) the food shall have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature or, 2) the food shall have an initial temperature of 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 3) the food shall be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 4) the food shall be cooked and served, served if ready to eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 5) the food if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit shall be discarded. Tapioca discarded

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed one live cockroach under a prep table in the back kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Please have a pest control service within 10 days. Provide receipt of service to EHS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed cracked eggs to be used for baking stored in a container on the floor in the preparation area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Container of cracked eggs moved onto table.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for SEASONINGS were observed reused for the storage of OILS AND OTHER FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS discussed container usage with PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: Metal banded brush observed used in butter spread topping for pastries.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. Metal banded brush removed and replaced with a silicone banded brush. SHILLA PATISSERIE & CAFE (Inspection Date: 05/05/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present during this visit, manager present has expired CFM certification.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A follow up visit will be conducted to ensure a CFM is present.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: non NSF Bread Slicer
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the 3 VAT SINK being used to CLEAN SPATULA FOR CAKE ICING.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS asked employee to wash spatula in 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: Establishment observed with NO available sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. Employee went to store and purchased a gallon of bleach.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: non NSF bread slicer
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Interior of ice machine observed with discoloration.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: stirrers at coffee area observed in container of ambient water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Discussed utensil usage with PIC to store stirrers in dry container and wash when needed.
